content:
A **Sweet Roll** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Consuming the item deals two Radiation damage, restores 90 HP and 300 AP, while also increasing Charisma by three for 90 minutes.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Purified Water (2) Spices (2) Sugar (3) Sugar Bombs (3) Wood (1) | | **Built or Scrapped:****Plan:** | | Sweet Roll (1) | 

- Four can be found inside a wicker basket between two rocking chairs, on the porch of the blue-gray house, northwest of the Red Rocket in Berkeley Springs.
- One can be found inside the Grafton Steel Underground.
- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station, after having learned the recipe.
- May be given by a Miss Nanny in a random encounter after listening to her story.
- May be bought from Mr. Waiter at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
- May be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.
